scope: Primary post-2024-09-15 external sources for small-molecule IRI evaluation. One public experimental supplement was acquired and inspected; no condition-matched numeric external test set has been assembled or scored.

screening_notes.date_rule: Publication date is after 2024-09-15 (the Warren et al. Nature Communications paper is therefore not repeated here).
screening_notes.alreadyseen40papers: The existing 40-paper list is data/pilot-studies.json. DOI checks found no exact DOI overlap with any of the four leads below; title/structure-level overlap was not inferred.
screening_notes.dolmen_overlap: No compound-level overlap is asserted. The pinned DOLMEN data are the 2024 Amino/Glyco/Glyco2 benchmark; checking structures in the paywalled/supplementary candidates would require acquiring files and was not performed.
screening_notes.eligibility_summary: Two records are direct experimental IRI sources. Two additional records are primary small-molecule ice/cryoprotection mechanism leads but computational-only and must not supply training labels.

sources.title: Do Inhibition Studies of Ice Crystallization Indicate Cryoprotectant Efficacy?
sources.materialclass: small molecules (saccharides and other low-molecular-mass compounds); polymers and proteins are also tested in the same study and must be filtered out
sources.dataavailability: Official ACS Figshare record 29185191 is public and supplies cg5c00221_si_001.pdf (5,260,937 bytes; application/pdf; MD5 0adbefadfeada8a496b3a825b4b0edcf). The SI contains IRI splat raw images, grain-size distribution plots, experimental methods, and small-molecule/material lists; it does not expose a machine-readable structure/activity table.
sources.readstatus: abstract, publisher metadata, official Figshare API metadata, and all 24 SI PDF pages read; pages 1-2 visually inspected with Poppler rendering
sources.primarysupport: ACS publisher record plus official ACS Figshare SI record/API (article 29185191) and downloaded SI PDF.

acquisition.download_status: downloaded via scripts/with_external_storage.py; hash verified against Figshare metadata; no presentation or main-article bypass downloaded

sources.assay_conditions: IRI splat assay uses triplicate runs and 5, 15, and 30 minute time points; SI documents cross-polarized microscopy, image preprocessing/Cellpose 3 segmentation, ROI filtering, and grain-size distributions. Tested low-molecular-mass materials include glucose, sucrose, maltose, trehalose, DMSO, glycerol, cysteamine, and L-histidine; polymers/protein are separately present and must be excluded. The SI's IRI figures are condition-specific and do not provide a DOLMEN-compatible machine-readable table.
sources.endpoint_comparability: The endpoint is splat-assay grain-size distribution/IRI image analysis and is directionally related to DOLMEN %MGS, but time points, formulation details, image-analysis pipeline, and material panel differ. Use only for a separately conditioned external evaluation after structure/condition curation; no numeric outcomes were transcribed.
sources.eligibility: Original experimental source acquired, but not eligible for pooled 20/22 mM %MGS evaluation as currently available: reported small-molecule conditions include 1 mM, and the SI presents grain-area distributions without a verified compatible normalization table. Reserve as a condition-shift source; do not add training labels.
sources.independence_caveats: Eligible direct experimental lead, but assay conditions and concentration regime differ from DOLMEN and may not be directly poolable. The study reports mixed material classes, so a small-molecule-only extraction and structure normalization are required. Do not transcribe numeric outcomes into training data without a preregistered condition mapping.

sources.title: Self-assembled nanostructures of 3ph-imi[FeCl4] as a strong ice recrystallization inhibitor
sources.materialclass: small-molecule imidazole-based ionic liquids with triphenyl groups (3ph-imi[X]); self-assembled molecular/nanostructured materials
sources.dataavailability: Publisher record and abstract are accessible; full text is access restricted. Supplementary files, machine-readable structures, assay-condition labels, and raw IRI measurements were not verified.
sources.readstatus: publisher abstract/metadata read; experimental IRI claim confirmed; full text and data not read
sources.primarysupport: ScienceDirect publisher article record and abstract; no secondary summary used for the experimental claim.
sources.independence_caveats: Promising independent direct-IRI lead, but self-assembly and ionic-liquid counterion effects make it chemically distant from DOLMEN Amino/Glyco2. Treat as a prospective external challenge set only after obtaining structures, formulation conditions, and raw replicate data; no label extraction has been done.

sources.title: Collective mechanism of ice recrystallization inhibition by small molecules
sources.materialclass: small-molecule solutes and self-assembled solute nanocrystals (theoretical mechanism study)
sources.dataavailability: Primary abstract and bibliographic record are accessible; no experimental compound-by-condition IRI dataset was identified.
sources.primarysupport: RSC DOI record is the primary publication; PubMed was used only to confirm bibliographic metadata and abstract.
sources.independence_caveats: Screened out for label generation: this is a theoretical model paper that interprets prior experimental trends, not a new experimental IRI source. It may inform mechanism/compatibility review only.

sources.title: Molecular dynamics of ice-active solutions at ice-water interfaces
sources.date_type: online publication 2025-08-07; Journal of Chemical Physics 163(21), 214501
sources.materialclass: small solutes including DMSO, methanediol, formic acid/formate, ammonium chloride, sodium chloride, and sodium fluoride
sources.dataavailability: Primary abstract and DOI metadata are accessible; reported work is molecular-dynamics simulation with no experimental IRI measurements or label table identified.
sources.primarysupport: AIP DOI record is the primary publication; PubMed was used only to confirm bibliographic metadata and abstract.
sources.independence_caveats: Screened out for label generation: computational ice-interface mechanism study, not an experimental IRI source. It can support condition/assay compatibility hypotheses only and must not be presented as an independent external test.
